versions.changelog:
- Updated version from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 in metadata.
- No changes to core logic or documentation content.

Initial release of image-watermark

- Supports batch watermarking for PNG/JPG images with custom text.
- Offers optional controls: watermark position (tiled, centered, bottom-right), opacity, and font size.
- Automatically adapts watermark font size based on image dimensions.
- Ensures output image quality with non-intrusive, semi-transparent watermarks.
- Handles multiple images by processing and returning them in bulk.
- Fully supports Chinese watermark text.
